wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Command center package
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Entry point of the read-only overview that takes one snapshot of a workspace's projects and runs.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Needs your attention
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Works out what needs the owner, such as pending approvals, and lists it most urgent first.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Closed runs list
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Reads the list of runs the owner closed so they stop asking for attention.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Memory summary
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Counts the shared memory notes by type and flags any that are malformed.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Tasks and sales feed
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Reads the ops task list through its own command so open items can appear in the attention list.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Project finder
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Finds every repository, branch and worktree in the workspace and reports what could not be read.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Run finder
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Finds every run in each project's run folder and keeps the most recently updated copy of each.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Git filter finder
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Reads git settings as plain text to find content filters that could run commands, without running git.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Safe git reader
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Runs only a short list of read-only git commands and strips passwords from web addresses.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Snapshot data shapes
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Defines the shape of the snapshot: projects, runs, pending approvals, costs and where each fact came from.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Safe ops reader
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Runs only two read-only forms of the ops command; the only program besides git that the overview starts.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Path helpers
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Shared tools to compare folders reliably, including through shortcuts, and to spot paths inside password folders.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Overview page builder
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Turns the snapshot into one self-contained web page and writes nothing itself.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Run details
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Reads one run's events, quality result, waiting approvals and cost; cost shows unknown rather than zero.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Snapshot writer
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Assembles everything into one snapshot and writes the data file and web page outside the workspace.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.name: Spanish page text
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/command_ce.description: Holds every Spanish sentence shown on the overview page.
